title: The AI Site Auditor — Field Guide
eyebrow: Plate 46 · a field guide of its own
footer: The AI Site Auditor · code in [forward-qa-agents](https://github.com/akc031185/forward-qa-agents) · companion guides: [The Forward Deployed Tester](https://akc031185.github.io/forward-deployed-tester/), [The SDET Architect](https://akc031185.github.io/sdet-architect/), [QA Agents](https://akc031185.github.io/qa-agents/).
heroH1: A site that looks finished in a browser can be empty to every AI assistant.
heroLead: Point the agent at a site built with Lovable, Bolt, v0, Replit or a Vite/CRA export.
It compares what AI crawlers receive with what a browser renders, checks access per AI agent, search SEO, and the mistakes AI builders leave behind.
One evaluation page with three grades: AI visibility, Search, Build quality.
primerP: Most AI crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) fetch HTML and never run JavaScript.
Google needs nothing AI-specific: a page must be indexable and eligible for a snippet.
51 deterministic checks with fixed severities; no model decides anything.
Secrets found in bundles are redacted everywhere; only the audited host is ever fetched.
